title: Laravel Cloud Integration
summary: Connect Resend to your Laravel Cloud applications in a few clicks.
body_markdown:
Sending email from a Laravel app usually means creating an API key, copying it into your environment, and configuring a sender by hand.


Today, we're introducing the **Laravel Cloud integration** . Add Resend as a resource on your Laravel Cloud canvas, sign in with OAuth, and your environment is ready to send.


## How it works


- **Connect once** : the integration is account-wide, so you authorize Resend a single time.
- **Attach anywhere** : add Resend to multiple Laravel Cloud applications.
- **No keys to copy** : provision keys for each environment.


## Add Resend from the canvas


Open your application's canvas in[Laravel Cloud](https://laravel.com/cloud) to get started.


Click **Add resource** , choose **email** , sign in with your Resend account, and approve access. Choose` full access` to manage your sending domain and sender details from within Laravel Cloud.


Once the OAuth connection completes, pick a sending domain and set the sender name and address.


If you haven't installed the[PHP Resend package](https://github.com/resend/resend-php) , you'll be prompted to do so within your project's dependencies. Deploy, and your app sends through Resend.


## Programmatic access


You can also attach Resend to an environment with the[Laravel Cloud API](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/api/email/attach-resend-to-environment) .


```text
curl   --  request   POST   \       --  url https  :  /  /  cloud  .  laravel  .  com  /  api  /  environments  /  {  environment  }  /  resend \       --  header   'Authorization: Bearer <token>'   \       --  header   'Content-Type: application/json'   \       --  data '    {        "from_address"  :     "jsmith@example.com"  ,        "from_name"  :     "<string>"  ,        "key_name"  :     "<string>"  ,        "reuse_key_id"  :     "<string>"     }    '
```


[View the full API documentation](https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/api/email/attach-resend-to-environment) for more details.


## Manage access


You can view or revoke the integration's OAuth permissions anytime from your Resend account's Team settings.


## Build with Laravel and PHP


Once connected, use everything Resend offers from your app:


- [Send emails with Laravel](https://resend.com/docs/send-with-laravel) using the` resend/resend-laravel` package.
- [Send emails with Laravel over SMTP](https://resend.com/docs/send-with-laravel-smtp) .
- [Send emails with PHP](https://resend.com/docs/send-with-php) for non-Laravel code.


## Conclusion


Laravel Cloud and Resend now work together out of the box. Read the[Laravel Cloud integration guide](https://resend.com/docs/guides/laravel-cloud-integration) for full setup details.


If you have any questions, please reach out to us and we'll be happy to help.
